skill.name: theme-factory

skill.summary: Style artifacts with ready-made professional themes or a custom generated theme.
skill.author: ComposioHQ

content.value_statement: Visual artifacts often look inconsistent when colors and fonts are chosen ad hoc. This skill applies curated themes to create polished, readable, branded outputs.
actual_capabilities: Shows a bundled PDF showcase of ten available themes.
Guides users to choose a theme before applying it.
Applies theme colors and fonts to slides, documents, reports, or HTML artifacts.
Uses bundled Markdown theme files with palette and typography details.
Creates a custom theme when the preset options do not fit.
limitations: It does not generate the artifact content itself unless asked separately.
It depends on the host tool being able to view or use the PDF showcase.
It requires user confirmation before selecting a preset theme.
Custom themes still need review for readability and brand fit.

use_cases.title: Refresh a presentation deck
use_cases.description: Apply one selected theme across an existing slide deck for consistent colors, fonts, and visual identity.

use_cases.title: Style a client report
use_cases.description: Use a professional theme to make a report easier to read and aligned with its audience.

use_cases.title: Create a custom visual direction
use_cases.description: Generate a new theme from a short description when the ten presets do not match the artifact.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a preset theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the available theme showcase and help me choose a theme for my presentation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner users who want to browse the built-in options first.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a selected theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this deck and keep the layout readable.
prompt_templates.scenario: Users who already know which preset theme they want.

prompt_templates.title: Match an audience
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a theme for an executive strategy report, explain the choice, then apply it after I confirm.
prompt_templates.scenario: Users who want guidance based on audience and tone.

prompt_templates.title: Create a custom theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a modern healthcare landing page, show the palette and fonts, then wait for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced users who need a new visual direction beyond the presets.

output_examples.input: Apply a calm professional theme to my quarterly business review deck.
output_examples.output: I would show the theme showcase, recommend Ocean Depths or Modern Minimalist, ask for confirmation, then apply the selected palette and fonts.

output_examples.input: None of the themes fit our new product launch page.
output_examples.output: I would create a custom theme proposal with colors, header font, body font, and usage guidance for review.

output_examples.input: Make this technical report look more modern.
output_examples.output: I would suggest Tech Innovation, confirm the choice, then apply its bold colors and typography while preserving readability.

best_practices: Review the PDF showcase before choosing a theme.
Confirm the selected theme before applying it to an artifact.
Check contrast and readability after applying colors and fonts.
anti_patterns: Do not apply a theme before the user confirms the choice.
Do not mix several preset themes in the same artifact.
Do not ignore accessibility when using dramatic color palettes.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill includes ten preset themes, each with a color palette and font pairing.

faq.question: Can it create a new theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate a custom theme from a basic description when no preset fits.

faq.question: Does it work only for slide decks?
faq.answer: No. The instructions mention slides, documents, reports, HTML landing pages, and other artifacts.

faq.question: Does the skill include theme details?
faq.answer: Yes. Each theme has a bundled Markdown file with palette and typography specifications.

faq.question: Will it choose a theme automatically?
faq.answer: No. It should ask for the user's choice and wait for confirmation before applying a theme.

faq.question: Is the PDF required?
faq.answer: The PDF is used as a visual showcase, but the theme definitions also exist in the themes directory.
